text: Imagine you're a macaque, snug in bed, having a quiet moment under the covers.
Now imagine you do it faster, and faster, and faster.
Five kilometres per hour. Just another Tuesday.
Fifty. Your arm buzzes like a hummingbird's wings,
and the FBI agents spying on you start to freak out.
No way! It can't be!
Three hundred. As fast as a bullet.
The friction burns so much...
Blimey! You've set your favourite Cars bedsheets on fire.
One thousand three hundred. You break the sound barrier.
The macaques protest on the news:
you're making them look terrible.
Half the speed of light. For you, time slows right down,
and you start time-travelling, fuelled by pure elbow grease.
At ninety per cent, atoms start to fuse,
and you release energy across the whole world.
At ninety-nine point nine, you're as fast as the protons at CERN.
You discover the God particle, and they give you the Nobel Prize.
But you keep going,
and you concentrate so much energy that you turn into a star.
Until you collapse, and create the very first black hole.
And all of humanity ends up in the remains of your bedsheets.
So, for everyone's sake, send this to a friend, so he can relax a little.
